product_one_liner.value: Trackforce provides a physical-security operations platform for guarding companies and enterprise security teams to manage patrols, incident reporting, scheduling, billing and payroll.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing page describes configurable modules and quote factors; numerical prices require a custom quote.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 424 employees; the headcount's reporting date is unspecified.

hq_location.notes: Location reported by the company profile.

eng_blog.notes: The inspected index contains industry guidance and product content, rather than at least two engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: TrackTik's public help center covers operations, workforce management, billing, analytics, developer tools and release notes.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page lists two roles—Enterprise Sales Director and Major Accounts Account Manager—and neither is a qualifying AI/ML/data-science role.

model_provider.notes: No named provider was found in the inspected ReportPro AI product/help content, trust page or privacy policy. The DPA references a subprocessor schedule, but its contents were not available in the inspected material.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certification, plus GDPR compliance; GDPR is not itself a certification.

last_funding.notes: Latest round reported by CB Insights: July 27, 2023, for $0.37 million. Funding sources disagree; a separate 2026 report could not be conclusively tied to trackforce.com.

raised_18mo.notes: CB Insights dates the latest reported round to July 2023, before May 9, 2025. An uncorroborated 2026 funding report could not be conclusively matched to this company.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Account Executive – Mid Market SaaS Security Workforce Management Software posting has an active application link, although it is not listed on the main careers page.

launched_6mo.notes: On June 9, 2026, Trackforce introduced Job-Based Views: five role-specific live views available to TrackTik customers.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Scott Kaine was appointed CEO on January 12, 2026, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Sales postings explicitly require Salesforce pipeline and CRM hygiene. Other named tools are presented as alternative experience requirements, not confirmed deployments.
